objective.name: sandbox.echo
objective.description: Wrapper-backed echo capacity for N5 inter-instance tests

#root.role: Return an echo payload from the local wrapper runtime.

transformation_contract.morphing: A wrapper echo request becomes an explicit echoed message returned by the local wrapper runtime.
invariants: The wrapper always echoes the supplied message as a string, including the empty-string case.
The returned ctx_id and wrapper_name are derived from the active wrapper runtime environment.
The capability does not mutate any engine or wrapper state.
success: On success, sandbox.echo returns echo, handled_by, ctx_id, and wrapper_name.
handled_by is a stable sandbox capability marker identifying the local wrapper implementation.
failure: sandbox.echo has no contract-level validation failure for missing message because the wrapper coerces absent values to an empty string.
The capability only fails if the underlying wrapper runtime cannot execute.
notes: This sandbox capability is intentionally simple and is used as a stable wrapper oracle in N3, N5, and N7 tests.
The response is fully wrapper-backed and does not involve outbound calls.
